delivered.body: Confidential Settlement Agreement RECITALS. Plaintiff Harrow and Defendant Delmar wish to resolve all claims. 1. PAYMENT. The Defendant shall pay the Plaintiff the Settlement Amount set out below, which shall not exceed the sum specified herein, being Forty-Five Million Five Hundred Thousand Dollars (USD 45,500,000). The terms of this settlement are strictly confidential. 4. NO ADMISSION. This settlement is not an admission of liability.
